name: 78. Bedrock Mantle chat streaming keeps the trailing usage chunk after finish_reason (#7065 / PR #7076)
description: Regression coverage for PR #7076 (fixes #7065). Bedrock Mantle's OpenAI-compatible chat streaming surface sends the finish_reason chunk, then, when stream_options.include_usage is set, a usage-only chunk with choices: [], then [DONE]. ProviderSendsDoneMarker answered false for bedrock and bedrock_mantle, so the shared streaming loop treated finish_reason as terminal and never read the usage chunk: streamed token counts and cost were silently dropped. The fix lists both providers as [DONE] senders. Both cases send include_usage and assert that a usage object with prompt/completion/total tokens above zero reaches the client AFTER the finish_reason chunk. The bedrock/ row pins the legacy in-provider Mantle route (an OpenAI-family model under the bedrock key still hits the Mantle host and sees the same wire order); the bedrock_mantle/ row pins the dedicated provider. Before this folder no Mantle streaming case asserted usage values.

item.name: bedrock/openai.gpt-5.6-sol /v1/chat/completions streaming with include_usage keeps the trailing usage chunk after finish_reason (legacy Mantle route) - #7065

exec: pm.test('bedrock legacy Mantle route gpt-5.6-sol: stream completes with [DONE] - #7065', function () {
var finishIndex = -1, usageIndex = -1, doneIndex = -1, usage = null, seen = 0;
if (line === 'data: [DONE]') { seen++; if (doneIndex === -1) { doneIndex = seen; } continue; }
for (var c = 0; c < choices.length; c++) { if (choices[c].finish_reason && finishIndex === -1) { finishIndex = seen; } }
if (chunk.usage && typeof chunk.usage === 'object') { usageIndex = seen; usage = chunk.usage; }
pm.test('bedrock legacy Mantle route gpt-5.6-sol: trailing usage chunk carries token counts - #7065', function () {
pm.expect(usage, 'no chunk carried a usage object; the stream loop stopped at finish_reason (pre-#7065 behavior)').to.not.equal(null);
pm.expect(usageIndex, 'usage must ride the finish_reason chunk or a later one (finish=' + finishIndex + ', usage=' + usageIndex + ')').to.be.at.least(finishIndex);
pm.expect(doneIndex, 'expected exactly one [DONE] frame after the usage chunk (usage=' + usageIndex + ', done=' + doneIndex + ')').to.be.above(usageIndex);
pm.expect(seen, '[DONE] must be the last frame; frames after it are invisible to clients (done=' + doneIndex + ', frames=' + seen + ')').to.equal(doneIndex);
